Enjin Blockchain REST API

This project is a modified fork of Polkadot REST API by Parity Technologies:
https://github.com/paritytech/polkadot-rest-api
Upstream base: 283555b8e8e9cf488b11e9dbc1ba5f12344f5319 (v0.3.2).

Enjin fork modifications, 2026-10-08: Enjin and Canary Relaychain/Matrixchain
support, runtime selection and public routes for Enjin Blockchain, product branding,
documentation, packaging, monitoring, and CI/release configuration.
The Rust crates retain their upstream names; the executable is enjin-rest-api.
Copyright (C) 2026 Enjin for these contributions.

Original copyright and SPDX notices remain in the source files. The project
remains licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later; see LICENSE. Third-party dependencies
retain their own licenses and notices. No endorsement by Parity is implied.

Fork source: https://github.com/enjin/blockchain-rest-api
When distributing binaries, containers, or documentation bundles, provide
recipients the corresponding source for that exact revision and the required
license notices. A private repository link alone does not provide source to
recipients who cannot access it. See RELEASE.md.
